name: unleash
description: Put risky changes behind Unleash flags, roll them out gradually, and remove stale flags from your code

setup.notice: Requires an Unleash instance and a personal access token that can create and manage flags. The server runs with npx and needs Node.js 24 or later.
steps: In Unleash, create a personal access token from your profile
Enter your instance's root URL, without /api, and the token
